houseStats.name: Comfort
houseStats.effect: High comfort makes cats breed more and fight less. Each cat past the fourth in a room lowers it by 1, and so does each poop.
houseStats.target: Keep it positive. 5-10 or more for breeding; 2-5 is enough early on.

houseStats.name: Stimulation
houseStats.effect: Raises the chance that a kitten inherits the higher of its parents' base stats and their skills and mutations.
houseStats.target: The key stat of the breeding room. Do not push breeding hard before about 20.

houseStats.name: Health
houseStats.effect: Cures injuries, slows ageing and stops diseases from spreading. Low health lets old cats die suddenly.
houseStats.target: Some everywhere. Contagious diseases only clear with health, a lucky battle or an event.

houseStats.name: Mutation
houseStats.effect: Chance that cats mutate. Most mutations are +2 to one stat and -1 to another, so they are a net gain.
houseStats.target: Put it where strays and kittens sleep, not in the breeding room.

houseStats.name: Appeal
houseStats.effect: Applies to the whole house. Higher appeal brings strays with better stats and skills every day.
houseStats.target: Useful early; matters less once you have a strong core of cats. Keep the items in a storage room.

inherits: Base stats, mutations, genetic modifiers and some abilities. Bonus stats (from fights and adventures) are not passed on: a high-stat veteran is worth less than a stray with good base stats.
Tink's upgrade shows total, base and bonus stats side by side. Without it you cannot tell them apart.
When a kitten inherits an ability from a parent, the game rolls against the room's Stimulation. If it fails, a random grey ability is used instead.
A parent's disorders are inherited too, because the game treats them as innate.

odds.what: Kitten gets the higher of its parents' base stat
Kitten inherits one of a parent's spells (actives)
Mutation in a body slot that both parents have

roomRules: You never need more than 8-12 breeders. Thirty breeders meant 12-15 kittens a night and low comfort.
Keep the breeding room at 50/50 male and female, with comfort of at least 5 and preferably above 10.
Keep gay and low-libido cats out. Each night a cat targets one other cat, and if it is a gay cat no kittens are made.
A bisexual cat that keeps going for the same sex should be treated as gay.
Cats that fall in love breed nearly every night. Put the pair you want in a spare room until they pair up, then move them.
Charisma helps breeding chances. Libido controls how often cats initiate and accept.
Purge: a cat without a 7 in some stat, or without all stats between 5 and 6, does not belong in the breeding room.
Base stats come first. A cat with good base stats can still gain mutations; a cat with good mutations and bad base stats can never fix its stats.

plans.title: Three roles
plans.summary: The simple setup: one room for breeding, one for storage and one fight club.

rooms.name: Breeding room
rooms.use: Your best cats with high base stats. Keep them in love and stop adding strangers.

rooms.name: Storage room
rooms.use: Kittens, strays and cats that are neither good for breeding nor for fights.

rooms.name: Fight club
rooms.use: Cats before they leave on runs. Winners of a fight get a random stat boost.

notes: Take strays that have several 6s or at least one 7. 7s are very important.
Kittens cannot fight, so you can put mutation furniture in the fight club and move kittens there on their first night.

plans.title: Three-room rotation
plans.summary: Breed, store and pair in separate rooms, so good cats keep coming. Needs 3+ rooms, Tink's upgrades and a Totem that blocks breeding.

rooms.name: 1. Breeding room
rooms.stats: High stimulation, some health, no mutation, comfort 5+
rooms.use: A handful of breeding cats, all in love with each other. Mark parents and kittens with the same icon.

rooms.name: 2. Incubation and storage
rooms.stats: High comfort, some mutation, little health, no-breeding Totem
rooms.use: Offspring and strays. They cannot breed there, so mutation furniture can slowly give new traits.

rooms.name: 3. Dating room
rooms.use: Pair an offspring with a stray here, then move the couple to room 1. When one of a pair dies, discard both.

notes: Ideal parents together reach 7 in every stat (6/7/7 plus 7/6/1 can give 7/7/7). One parent should carry the mutations, the other none.
Skills are a bonus of this plan, not the goal.

phases.name: Early
phases.aim: High Constitution and Speed. Stats matter less than picking the right class and wearing armour.

phases.name: Early-mid
phases.aim: High Constitution, max Speed, and at least 5 stats above 5.

phases.name: Mid
phases.aim: High Constitution, max Speed and at least 5 stats above 6. Start placing mutation furniture in your storage room.

phases.name: Mid-late
phases.aim: 5 to 7 stats at 7, Constitution and Speed maxed. Kittens should inherit 3+ mutations you want, ideally the reroll mutations.

phases.name: Late
phases.aim: Same stats, with 5+ wanted mutations. The author carries 3 reroll mutations on his cats.

orientation.result: Kittens. A ditto acts as male or female, so it lets gay cats pass on their traits.

orientationNotes: A ditto is a cat with both a sausage and a donut, shown as ?. It can breed with other dittos too.
Gay cats can block a breeding event that would have happened. Once you have 20 stimulation, discard most gay and low-libido cats from the breeding room.
Tink's third upgrade shows orientation as flags. Until then you only notice it from night events.
inbreeding: Inbred kittens are more often ugly, with birth defects that lower stats. It can happen even when parents are distant relatives.
Bring in strays: they are not related to anyone. Check the family tree and give each branch its own icon.
You need Tink's second upgrade to see the inbreeding level. A slightly inbred cat can simply go on a run and then to Tink.
furniture: Toxic Waste Barrel: +4 Stimulation, -2 Comfort. A breeding powerhouse; offset the comfort in another room.
Microwave and Newspapers: +1 Comfort each, cheap fillers.
Daruma Statue: -1 Comfort, +1 Stimulation, +1 Appeal. An early Appeal boost.
Food Storage: +40 max food, so you can keep breeding without a run.
Rare furniture doubles the effect. Act 1 hard paths give normal furniture; Act 2 can give rare. Pick the cardboard box, not the golden chest.

sides: Meta Breeding Guide: early on, put cats with grey abilities in the breeding room. Brainstorm, Copycat and the like are very strong, and you can breed an army of them at the start.
Reddit post: do not focus on abilities. Your stimulation is rarely high enough for reliable ability breeding, so spend it on base stats and mutations.
discrepancies.verdict: Both agree on stimulation: reach about 20 first. Only then does ability breeding work.

sides: Meta Breeding Guide and the Rough guide (marked outdated since 1.1x): inbreeding is not a serious problem, even a strategy once parents are all 7s.
Breeding Basics, Greenside and Reddit: avoid it, use strays and the family tree. The Rough guide says the devs made negative traits more likely the more inbred a cat is.
discrepancies.verdict: Treat inbreeding as harmful and rotate in strays.

sides: Meta Breeding Guide and the Rough guide: about 20 is the point to start breeding seriously; the Rough guide says you can start from 0.
Greenside: the odds climb slowly. 50 stimulation gives a 60% chance of the better stat, and it takes 300 to reach 80%.
discrepancies.verdict: 20 is a starting point, not a plateau. Keep stacking stimulation in the breeding room.

sides: Rough guide: 5-10 or more for breeding.
Meta Breeding Guide: about 4, removing cats to keep it there.
Reddit post: above 10 for lots of kittens; 2-5 is enough early.
